layman_headline: Market fear is high and most coins are bleeding — patience is the smartest play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful state at 28/100, with Bitcoin down almost 4% this week and most altcoins performing even worse. There's negative news pressure from a Coldcard hardware wallet exploit dragging sentiment, Strategy selling Bitcoin, and uncertainty around the CLARITY Act in the Senate. None of the swing trade candidates present a clean, high-conviction setup — the best-looking ones either have too much momentum risk (UB up 33% in a week) or are in confirmed downtrends (TRUMP, WLD). The smart move is to wait for either the fear to deepen into a genuine capitulation buy opportunity, or for conditions to stabilize.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is nervous and falling, and there's no standout trade worth risking capital on right now. Watch for Bitcoin to find a floor or for fear to spike even lower, which could create better buying opportunities in the coming days.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven candidates systematically. UB has the strongest chart bias (+1.1) with Three White Soldiers and bullish structure, but it's already up 33% in 7 days — chasing extended momentum in a fearful market with 56.2% BTC dominance (hostile to alts) is high-risk. TRUMP has the best RSI signal at 26.2 (oversold), which historically has a 71% win rate per our signal credibility data, but its chart is bearish (-0.7 bias), it's below all moving averages, and it's down 98% from ATH — this is a falling knife, not a bounce setup. BEAT dropped 21% in a week but its RSI at 58 contradicts the dip narrative, suggesting structural weakness rather than oversold opportunity. AAVE is the most fundamentally sound (major DeFi protocol) but its chart is neutral-to-bearish with no catalyst. WLD has a decent risk/reward ratio (2.41x) but is below all MAs in bearish structure. The Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend suggests further downside is possible. Per my validated rules, F&G near 25 makes the outlook genuinely ambiguous — HOLD is appropriate.
